annotations.title: Move a thread to the trash

description: Move one thread, or one message of it, to the trash - Gmail's bin, an Outlook mailbox's Deleted Items, the trash folder of a mailbox whose provider is imap - where it stays until threads_untrash brings it back or the provider's own retention ends it. In a mailbox whose provider is imap each moved message takes a new id, which the answer names.

id.description: The threadId a search or a read answered, or with scope message the message's id.

mailbox.description: The mailbox's name or its email address.

scope.description: thread, the default, acts on the whole thread; message acts on that one message alone.

name: threads_trash
title: Move a thread to the trash
